# netskope_destination_profile (Resource)

DestinationProfile Resource

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "netskope_destination_profile" "my_destinationprofile" {
  description = "...my_description..."
  label_ids = [
    "..."
  ]
  name = "...my_name..."
  type = "sensitive"
  values = [
    "..."
  ]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Profile name (max 100 characters)
- `type` (String) Matching type for values. must be one of ["regex", "sensitive", "insensitive"]

### Optional

- `description` (String) Profile description (max 200 characters)
- `label_ids` (List of String) Associated label IDs
- `values` (List of String) List of destination URLs/domains

### Read-Only

- `profile_id` (String) Destination profile ID (UUID)

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

In Terraform v1.5.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `id` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = netskope_destination_profile.my_netskope_destination_profile
  id = "..."
}
```

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import netskope_destination_profile.my_netskope_destination_profile "..."
```
